description: A span with padding and border that wraps over lines is sliced: no border or padding at the cut.

florui.css: .p { width: 120px; background-color: #e8ecff; color: #112233; } .tag { padding: 2px 6px; border: 2px solid #3355cc; background-color: #dfe6ff; }

classification.reason: Measured against Chromium 153 on Windows: 7.63% of the pixels differ and the box is within 1px; what is left is the two engines' glyph antialiasing, as in the other text fixtures. Without the feature the same fixture measures 12.74% and the box is the same size, so it fails.
